question: T12 (task-e65866a058e60197), after #770 (CAP-T12REFIT2) and #772 (CAP-T12PHONE3): Text Style, Direction and Pause on hover after a Wave Intensity fall; a block below, above or beside a Scrolling block as its rows change, on the desktop and in the phone view; more than two blocks; Cmd+Z after these steps. On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan, the blocks added on the desktop (a new Text block lands on the desktop at 1/2/3/10 and in the phone view under the Scrolling block). Each plan is arranged in the view it reads (arrow keys on the selected block, or a drag and a bottom-right handle drag), then the Scrolling block is selected, Edit, Design, and the plan's steps run with a read after each; then Escape (let go) and a read, then each Cmd+Z with a read after it. Phone plans press Mobile View first (the frame 428 wide). Desktop: H 180>90>Text Style Paragraph; I a Text block moved to 3/2/5/10 (under the foot), 180>90; J 180>90>Fade edges; K a Text block at 4/2/6/10 (a row between), 180>90; Q the Text block left at 1/2/3/10 (on the Scrolling block's rows), 180>90; R the Scrolling block made 1/2/3/14 and the Text block 3/14/5/22 (below, in other columns), 180>90. Phone: A 180>150>Text Style Paragraph; B 180>150>Animation direction right; C 180>150>Pause on hover; U a Text block under it (3/2/5/10), 180>90; D the Text block at 4/2/6/10 (a row between), 180>90; E as U with the Text block added before the Scrolling block; F three Text blocks under it, 180>90; G the Scrolling block made 1/2/3/6 and the Text block 1/5/3/10 (beside, sharing column 5), 180>90; N the Text block moved to 1/2/3/10 and the Scrolling block to 3/2/5/10 (a block above), 180>90; O the Scrolling block 1/2/3/5 and the Text block 1/5/3/10 (beside, no shared column), 180>90; M the Scrolling block 1/2/3/5 and the Text block 3/5/5/10 (below, in other columns), 180>90. R1 read the plans in one order and R2 in the other, in separate edit sessions, so each plan was read in two sessions. Nothing saved: every session left by Exit Without Saving.
readsAre: layout: the Scrolling block's desktop and phone grid areas, rows (the section's row count in the view shown), rowSizes, block (height), marquee and svg ([top in the block, height]), paragraph and h1 (the line's words are a p or a heading), undo ([Undo on, Redo on]), ctl (each Direction, Speed, Pause on hover, Fade edges and Text Size control's label and on state, while the panel is open), ranges (each range: its label and value), all (each block in the section: me (the Scrolling block), kind, desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height). The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('z' is Cmd+Z). 'start' is the plan arranged, before Edit.
answer: Text Style Paragraph after a fall keeps the rows: desktop H stays 1/2/4/26 (block 124), phone A stays 1/2/6/10 (block 180); the words become a p and the line keeps its height. Direction right (B) and Pause on hover (C) keep the phone rows too. Cmd+Z then undoes the press and the rows stay.
Fade edges after a desktop fall (J) keeps 1/2/4/26, and Cmd+Z after it keeps them too.

On the desktop a block below the Scrolling block follows its foot, as in the phone view (#772): I's Text block 3/2/5/10 goes to 7/2/9/10 at 180 (foot 3 to 7) and 4/2/6/10 at 90; K's 4/2/6/10, a row between, goes to 8/2/10/10 and 5/2/7/10, keeping the row between; Q's Text block on the Scrolling block's rows (1/2/3/10) moves too, to 5/2/7/10 and 2/2/4/10. The section keeps its rows under the lowest block (8 > 12 > 9). R's Text block below in other columns (3/14/5/22) stays.

In the phone view the same: D's Text block a row below (4/2/6/10) goes to 9/2/11/10 and 6/2/8/10; F's three Text blocks under it all move by the foot's change; E (Text added first) reads as U. A block that shares a column and starts on the Scrolling block's top row moves too (G: 1/5/3/10 to 6/5/8/10 and 3/5/5/10). A block above it (N: 1/2/3/10 over 3/2/5/10), beside it in other columns (O: 1/5/3/10 by 1/2/3/5) or below it in other columns (M: 3/5/5/10 under 1/2/3/5) stays.
Cmd+Z after each wave step goes back one step, the Scrolling block and the blocks that moved alike, and the section rows with them.
R1 and R2 read alike in all 119 reads, apart from Undo and Redo at a plan's start (Redo stays on from the plan before).
Not read: a block that starts above the Scrolling block's top and reaches below it; a block hidden in a view; Text Style back to Heading; the items; Text Size with a block below.
